text:
zara: Heads-up from yesterday's onboarding session: the sampleapp silently switched creds when REDWOOD_PROJECT was set. user had REDWOOD_API_KEY in env but traffic went to org tenant.

ryan: ouch. can you paste the quick repro steps?

zara: repro:\n1) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_local_111\n2) export REDWOOD_PROJECT=team-green\n3) run `rw sampleapp dev`\nLogs show: `env key detected` then `resolved project metadata -> using org default pk_org_999` and subsequent calls go to org tenant.

kevin: sounds like the project provider path is winning over env var. we intended precedence: flag > env > file > project metadata. did the refactor change ordering?

zara: yep. auth/chain now short-circuits when REDWOOD_PROJECT exists and calls ProjectResolver first. ProjectResolver does a metadata lookup and returns org fallback if project missing/rotated, without checking explicit creds.

ryan: quick fix: short-circuit ProjectResolver with an explicitKey param or have resolver check `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` and CLI flags before metadata call.

kevin: agree. also add a one-line console warning when a metadata-based override would have happened. silent swaps are the worst for onboarding.

infra-bot: created DEVEX-2001: project metadata overriding explicit env key when REDWOOD_PROJECT set. linked PR template.

support-bot: suggested playbook: if user sees unexpected tenant, run `rw auth:whoami --json` and ask them to unset REDWOOD_PROJECT while debugging.

zara: another idea: emit a subtle telemetry event when fallback to org default occurs, so we can detect frequency and prioritize a fix.

ryan: good call. telemetry + local warning + `auth:whoami` should cut support volume.

kevin: i'll open a small PR to: 1) change precedence so env/flag wins, 2) add `rw auth:whoami` (prints effective key source), 3) add unit tests, and 4) emit audit log + telemetry on org-fallback.

zara: thanks. also can we update quickstart docs to recommend `--api-key` for tutorial steps (or a note to unset REDWOOD_PROJECT) until fix lands?

kevin: yes will add README blurb and update onboarding checklist for docs & support.

ryan: nice. low-risk patch. tag me on the PR for a quick review.

zara: thx everyone, saved a demo call :raised_hands:
